When Steamed Bun was chased and bitten by stray dogs, Hu Bapi grabbed a broom and charged forward; when Steamed Bun whined from hunger, Hu Bapi broke off the last half of his cornbread, grumbling, "Damn dog, stop barking."
Everyone hates him—except Steamed Bun.
